verses.original: ה֗וֹי עֲטֶ֤רֶת גֵּאוּת֙ שִׁכֹּרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצִ֥יץ נֹבֵ֖ל צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ גֵּֽיא־ שְׁמָנִ֖ים הֲל֥וּמֵי יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ gê·’ūṯ šik·kō·rê ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·ṣîṣ nō·ḇêl ṣə·ḇî ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš gê- šə·mā·nîm hă·lū·mê yā·yin
verses.literal: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards to the fading flower of his glorious splendor set on the summit above the fertile valley the pride of those overcome by wine
verses.literalPt: AI da coroa de soberba dos bêbados de Efraim, cujo glorioso ornamento é como a flor que cai, que está sobre a cabeça do fértil vale dos vencidos do vinho.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה חָזָ֤ק וְאַמִּץ֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔י כְּזֶ֥רֶם בָּרָ֖ד שַׂ֣עַר קָ֑טֶב כְּ֠זֶרֶם מַ֣יִם כַּבִּירִ֥ים שֹׁטְפִ֛ים הִנִּ֥יחַ לָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḥā·zāq wə·’am·miṣ la·ḏō·nāy kə·ze·rem bā·rāḏ śa·‘ar qā·ṭeḇ kə·ze·rem ma·yim kab·bî·rîm šō·ṭə·p̄îm hin·nî·aḥ lā·’ā·reṣ bə·yāḏ
verses.literal: Behold the Lord has one who is strong and mighty Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest like a driving rain . . . or flooding downpour . . . he will smash that crown . . . to the ground
verses.literalPt: Eis que o Senhor tem um forte e poderoso; como tempestade de saraiva, tormenta destruidora, e como tempestade de impetuosas águas que transbordam, ele, com a mão, derrubará por terra.

verses.original: בְּרַגְלַ֖יִם תֵּֽרָמַ֑סְנָה עֲטֶ֥רֶת גֵּא֖וּת שִׁכּוֹרֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·raḡ·la·yim tê·rā·mas·nāh ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ gê·’ūṯ šik·kō·w·rê ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot . . .
verses.literalPt: A coroa de soberba dos bêbados de Efraim será pisada aos pés.

verses.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה צִיצַ֤ת נֹבֵל֙ צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹ֖אשׁ גֵּ֣יא שְׁמָנִ֑ים כְּבִכּוּרָהּ֙ בְּטֶ֣רֶם קַ֔יִץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְאֶ֤ה הָֽרֹאֶה֙ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּעוֹדָ֥הּ בְּכַפּ֖וֹ יִבְלָעֶֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ṣî·ṣaṯ nō·ḇêl ṣə·ḇî ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš gê šə·mā·nîm kə·ḇik·kū·rå̄h bə·ṭe·rem qa·yiṣ ’ă·šer yir·’eh hā·rō·’eh ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·‘ō·w·ḏāh bə·ḵap·pōw yiḇ·lā·‘en·nāh
verses.literal: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor set on the summit above the fertile valley will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it
verses.literalPt: E a flor caída do seu glorioso ornamento, que está sobre a cabeça do fértil vale, será como o fruto temporão antes do verão, que, vendo-o alguém, e tendo-o ainda na mão, o engole.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַעֲטֶ֣רֶת צְבִ֔י וְלִצְפִירַ֖ת תִּפְאָרָ֑ה לִשְׁאָ֖ר עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yih·yeh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ la·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ṣə·ḇî wə·liṣ·p̄î·raṯ tip̄·’ā·rāh liš·’ār ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia o SENHOR dos Exércitos será por coroa gloriosa, e por diadema formosa, para os restantes de seu povo.

verses.original: וּלְר֖וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְלִ֨גְבוּרָ֔ה מְשִׁיבֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה שָֽׁעְרָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·rū·aḥ miš·pāṭ lay·yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- ham·miš·pāṭ wə·liḡ·ḇū·rāh mə·šî·ḇê mil·ḥā·māh šā·‘ə·rāh
verses.literal: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate
verses.literalPt: E por espírito de juízo, para o que se assenta a julgar, e por fortaleza para os que fazem recuar a peleja até à porta.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ בַּיַּ֣יִן שָׁג֔וּ וּבַשֵּׁכָ֖ר תָּע֑וּ כֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָבִיא֩ שָׁג֨וּ בַשֵּׁכָ֜ר נִבְלְע֣וּ מִן־ הַיַּ֗יִן תָּעוּ֙ מִן־ הַשֵּׁכָ֔ר שָׁגוּ֙ בָּֽרֹאֶ֔ה פָּק֖וּ פְּלִילִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’êl·leh bay·ya·yin šā·ḡū ū·ḇaš·šê·ḵār tā·‘ū kō·hên wə·nā·ḇî šā·ḡū ḇaš·šê·ḵār niḇ·lə·‘ū min- hay·ya·yin tā·‘ū min- haš·šê·ḵār šā·ḡū bā·rō·’eh pā·qū pə·lî·lî·yāh
verses.literal: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine They stumble because of strong drink muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments
verses.literalPt: Mas também estes erram por causa do vinho, e com a bebida forte se desencaminham; até o sacerdote e o profeta erram por causa da bebida forte; são absorvidos pelo vinho; desencaminham-se por causa da bebida forte; andam errados na visão e tropeçam no juízo.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ שֻׁלְחָנ֔וֹת מָלְא֖וּ קִ֣יא צֹאָ֑ה בְּלִ֖י מָקֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mā·lə·’ū qî ṣō·’āh bə·lî mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: For all their tables are covered with vomit there is not a place without filth
verses.literalPt: Porque todas as suas mesas estão cheias de vômitos e imundícia, e não há lugar limpo.

verses.original: אֶת־ מִי֙ יוֹרֶ֣ה דֵעָ֔ה וְאֶת־ מִ֖י יָבִ֣ין שְׁמוּעָ֑ה גְּמוּלֵי֙ מֵֽחָלָ֔ב עַתִּיקֵ֖י מִשָּׁדָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mî yō·w·reh ḏê·‘āh wə·’eṯ- mî yā·ḇîn šə·mū·‘āh gə·mū·lê mê·ḥā·lāḇ ‘at·tî·qê miš·šā·ḏā·yim
verses.literal: Whom is He trying to teach . . . To whom is He explaining His message To infants just weaned from milk To babies removed from the breast
verses.literalPt: A quem, pois, se ensinaria o conhecimento? E a quem se daria a entender doutrina? Ao desmamado do leite, e ao arrancado dos seios?

verses.original: כִּ֣י צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ צַ֣ו לָצָ֔ו קַ֥ו לָקָ֖ו קַ֣ו לָקָ֑ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֥יר שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṣaw lā·ṣāw ṣaw lā·ṣāw qaw lā·qāw qaw lā·qāw zə·‘êr šām zə·‘êr šām
verses.literal: For they hear Order on order order on order line on line line on line a little here a little there
verses.literalPt: Porque é mandamento sobre mandamento, mandamento sobre mandamento, regra sobre regra, regra sobre regra, um pouco aqui, um pouco ali.

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּלַעֲגֵ֣י שָׂפָ֔ה וּבְלָשׁ֖וֹן אַחֶ֑רֶת יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·la·‘ă·ḡê śā·p̄āh ū·ḇə·lā·šō·wn ’a·ḥe·reṯ yə·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh
verses.literal: Indeed with mocking lips and foreign tongues He will speak to this people
verses.literalPt: Assim por lábios gaguejantes, e por outra língua, falará a este povo.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אָמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֹ֤את הַמְּנוּחָה֙ הָנִ֣יחוּ לֶֽעָיֵ֔ף וְזֹ֖את הַמַּרְגֵּעָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּא שְׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ā·mar ’ă·lê·hem zōṯ ham·mə·nū·ḥāh hā·nî·ḥū le·‘ā·yêp̄ wə·zōṯ ham·mar·gê·‘āh wə·lō ’ā·ḇū šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: to whom He has said This is the place of rest let the weary rest this is the place of repose But they would not listen
verses.literalPt: Ao qual disse: Este é o descanso, dai descanso ao cansado; e este é o refrigério; porém não quiseram ouvir.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֜ם דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה צַ֣ו לָצָ֞ו צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ קַ֤ו לָקָו֙ קַ֣ו לָקָ֔ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֣יר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן יֵלְכ֜וּ וְכָשְׁל֤וּ אָחוֹר֙ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·hem də·ḇar- Yah·weh ṣaw lā·ṣāw ṣaw lā·ṣāw qaw lā·qāw qaw lā·qāw zə·‘êr šām zə·‘êr šām lə·ma·‘an yê·lə·ḵū wə·ḵā·šə·lū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·niš·bā·rū wə·nō·wq·šū wə·nil·kā·ḏū
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD to them will become Order on order order on order line on line line on line a little here a little there so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured ensnared and captured
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, a palavra do SENHOR lhes será mandamento sobre mandamento, mandamento sobre mandamento, regra sobre regra, regra sobre regra, um pouco aqui, um pouco ali; para que vão, e caiam para trás, e se quebrantem e se enlacem, e sejam presos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָצ֑וֹן מֹֽשְׁלֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’an·šê lā·ṣō·wn mō·šə·lê hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore hear the word of the LORD O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, pois, a palavra do SENHOR, homens escarnecedores, que dominais este povo que está em Jerusalém.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כָּרַ֤תְנֽוּ בְרִית֙ אֶת־ מָ֔וֶת וְעִם־ שְׁא֖וֹל עָשִׂ֣ינוּ חֹזֶ֑ה שִׁיט שׁוֹטֵ֤ף כִּֽי־ עָבַר לֹ֣א יְבוֹאֵ֔נוּ כִּ֣י שַׂ֧מְנוּ כָזָ֛ב מַחְסֵ֖נוּ וּבַשֶּׁ֥קֶר נִסְתָּֽרְנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·mar·tem kā·raṯ·nū ḇə·rîṯ ’eṯ- mā·weṯ wə·‘im- šə·’ō·wl ‘ā·śî·nū ḥō·zeh šīṭ šō·w·ṭêp̄ kî- ʿå̄·ḇar lō yə·ḇō·w·’ê·nū kî śam·nū ḵā·zāḇ maḥ·sê·nū ū·ḇaš·še·qer nis·tā·rə·nū
verses.literal: For you said We have made a covenant with death we have fashioned an agreement . . . with Sheol When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place
verses.literalPt: Porquanto dizeis: Fizemos aliança com a morte, e com o inferno fizemos acordo; quando passar o dilúvio do açoite, não chegará a nós, porque pusemos a mentira por nosso refúgio, e debaixo da falsidade nos escondemos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֛י יִסַּ֥ד בְּצִיּ֖וֹן אָ֑בֶן אֶ֣בֶן בֹּ֜חַן פִּנַּ֤ת יִקְרַת֙ מוּסָ֣ד מוּסָּ֔ד הַֽמַּאֲמִ֖ין לֹ֥א יָחִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî yis·saḏ bə·ṣî·yō·wn ’ā·ḇen ’e·ḇen bō·ḥan pin·naṯ yiq·raṯ mū·sāḏ mūs·sāḏ ham·ma·’ă·mîn lō yā·ḥîš
verses.literal: So this is what the Lord GOD says See I lay a stone in Zion a tested stone a precious cornerstone a sure foundation the one who believes will never be shaken
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu assentei em Sião uma pedra, uma pedra já provada, pedra preciosa de esquina, que está bem firme e fundada; aquele que crer não se apresse.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְקָ֔ו וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְמִשְׁקָ֑לֶת וְיָעָ֤ה בָרָד֙ מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב וְסֵ֥תֶר מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî miš·pāṭ lə·qāw ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·miš·qā·leṯ wə·yā·‘āh ḇā·rāḏ maḥ·sêh ḵā·zāḇ wə·sê·ṯer ma·yim yiš·ṭō·p̄ū
verses.literal: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies and water will flood your hiding place
verses.literalPt: E regrarei o juízo pela linha, e a justiça pelo prumo, e a saraiva varrerá o refúgio da mentira, e as águas cobrirão o esconderijo.

verses.original: וְכֻפַּ֤ר בְּרִֽיתְכֶם֙ אֶת־ מָ֔וֶת וְחָזוּתְכֶ֥ם אֶת־ שְׁא֖וֹל לֹ֣א תָק֑וּם שׁ֤וֹט שׁוֹטֵף֙ כִּ֣י יַֽעֲבֹ֔ר וִהְיִ֥יתֶם ל֖וֹ לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵup·par bə·rî·ṯə·ḵem ’eṯ- mā·weṯ wə·ḥā·zū·ṯə·ḵem ’eṯ- šə·’ō·wl lō ṯā·qūm šō·wṭ šō·w·ṭêp̄ kî ya·‘ă·ḇōr wih·yî·ṯem lōw lə·mir·mās
verses.literal: Your covenant with death will be dissolved and your agreement with Sheol will not stand When the overwhelming scourge passes through you will be trampled by it
verses.literalPt: E a vossa aliança com a morte se anulará; e o vosso acordo com o inferno não subsistirá; e, quando o dilúvio do açoite passar, então sereis por ele pisados.

verses.original: מִדֵּ֤י עָבְרוֹ֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ בַבֹּ֧קֶר בַּבֹּ֛קֶר יַעֲבֹ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה רַק־ זְוָעָ֖ה הָבִ֥ין שְׁמוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mid·dê ‘ā·ḇə·rōw yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ·ḵem kî- ḇab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer ya·‘ă·ḇōr bay·yō·wm ū·ḇal·lā·yə·lāh wə·hā·yāh raq- zə·wā·‘āh hā·ḇîn šə·mū·‘āh
verses.literal: As often as it passes through it will carry you away - it will sweep through morning after morning by day and by night . . . The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror
verses.literalPt: Desde que comece a passar, vos arrebatará, porque manhã após manhã passará, de dia e de noite; e será que somente o ouvir tal notícia causará grande turbação.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קָצַ֥ר הַמַּצָּ֖ע מֵֽהִשְׂתָּרֵ֑עַ וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה צָ֖רָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּֽס׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qā·ṣar ham·maṣ·ṣā‘ mê·hiś·tā·rê·a‘ wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵāh ṣā·rāh kə·hiṯ·kan·nês
verses.literal: Indeed the bed is too short to stretch out on and the blanket too small to wrap around you
verses.literalPt: Porque a cama será tão curta que ninguém se poderá estender nela; e o cobertor tão estreito que ninguém se poderá cobrir com ele.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כְהַר־ פְּרָצִים֙ יָק֣וּם יְהוָ֔ה כְּעֵ֖מֶק בְּגִבְע֣וֹן יִרְגָּ֑ז לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ זָ֣ר מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ נָכְרִיָּ֖ה עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵə·har- pə·rā·ṣîm yā·qūm Yah·weh kə·‘ê·meq bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn yir·gāz la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ma·‘ă·śê·hū zār ma·‘ă·śê·hū wə·la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw nā·ḵə·rî·yāh ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim He will rouse Himself as in the Valley of Gibeon to do His work His strange work and to perform His task His disturbing task
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR se levantará como no monte Perazim, e se irará, como no vale de Gibeão, para fazer a sua obra, a sua estranha obra, e para executar o seu ato, o seu estranho ato.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־ תִּתְלוֹצָ֔צוּ פֶּֽן־ יֶחְזְק֖וּ מֽוֹסְרֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ כָלָ֨ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tiṯ·lō·w·ṣā·ṣū pen- yeḥ·zə·qū mō·ws·rê·ḵem kî- ḵā·lāh wə·ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh šā·ma‘·tî mê·’êṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So now do not mock or your shackles will become heavier Indeed I have heard from the Lord GOD of Hosts a decree of destruction against the whole land
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, não mais escarneçais, para que vossos grilhões não se façam mais fortes; porque já ao Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos ouvi falar de uma destruição, e essa já está determinada sobre toda a terra.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ קוֹלִ֑י הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nū wə·šim·‘ū qō·w·lî haq·šî·ḇū wə·šim·‘ū ’im·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Listen and hear my voice Pay attention and hear what I say
verses.literalPt: Inclinai os ouvidos, e ouvi a minha voz; atendei bem e ouvi o meu discurso.

verses.original: הֲכֹ֣ל הַיּ֔וֹם יַחֲרֹ֥שׁ הַחֹרֵ֖שׁ לִזְרֹ֑עַ יְפַתַּ֥ח וִֽישַׂדֵּ֖ד אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḵōl hay·yō·wm ya·ḥă·rōš ha·ḥō·rêš liz·rō·a‘ yə·p̄at·taḥ wî·śad·dêḏ ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Does the plowman plow for planting every day Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil
verses.literalPt: Porventura lavra todo o dia o lavrador, para semear? Ou abre e desterroa todo o dia a sua terra?

verses.original: הֲלוֹא֙ אִם־ שִׁוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֥יץ קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֣ן יִזְרֹ֑ק וְשָׂ֨ם חִטָּ֤ה שׂוֹרָה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֣ה נִסְמָ֔ן וְכֻסֶּ֖מֶת גְּבֻלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’im- šiw·wāh p̄ā·ne·hā wə·hê·p̄îṣ qe·ṣaḥ wə·ḵam·mōn yiz·rōq wə·śām ḥiṭ·ṭāh śō·w·rāh ū·śə·‘ō·rāh nis·mān wə·ḵus·se·meṯ gə·ḇu·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: When he has leveled its surface does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots and rye within its border
verses.literalPt: Não é antes assim: quando já tem nivelado a sua superfície, então espalha nela ervilhaca, e semeia cominho; ou lança nela do melhor trigo, ou cevada escolhida, ou centeio, cada qual no seu lugar?

verses.original: וְיִסְּר֥וֹ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אֱלֹהָ֥יו יוֹרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yis·sə·rōw lam·miš·pāṭ ’ĕ·lō·hāw yō·w·ren·nū
verses.literal: For his God instructs and teaches him properly
verses.literalPt: O seu Deus o ensina, e o instrui acerca do que há de fazer.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בֶֽחָרוּץ֙ י֣וּדַשׁ קֶ֔צַח וְאוֹפַ֣ן עֲגָלָ֔ה עַל־ כַּמֹּ֖ן יוּסָּ֑ב כִּ֧י בַמַּטֶּ֛ה יֵחָ֥בֶט קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֥ן בַּשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇe·ḥā·rūṣ yū·ḏaš qe·ṣaḥ wə·’ō·w·p̄an ‘ă·ḡā·lāh ‘al- kam·mōn yūs·sāḇ kî ḇam·maṭ·ṭeh yê·ḥā·ḇeṭ qe·ṣaḥ wə·ḵam·mōn baš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin But caraway is beaten out with a stick and cumin with a rod
verses.literalPt: Porque a ervilhaca não se trilha com trilho, nem sobre o cominho passa roda de carro; mas com uma vara se sacode a ervilhaca, e o cominho com um pau.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם יוּדָ֔ק כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח אָד֣וֹשׁ יְדוּשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְ֠הָמַם גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו לֹֽא־ יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem yū·ḏāq kî lō lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’ā·ḏō·wōš yə·ḏū·šen·nū wə·hā·mam gil·gal ‘eḡ·lā·ṯōw ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw lō- yə·ḏuq·qen·nū
verses.literal: Grain for bread must be ground but it is not endlessly threshed . . . . . . Though the wheels of the cart roll over it the horses do not crush it
verses.literalPt: O trigo é esmiuçado, mas não se trilha continuamente, nem se esmiúça com as rodas do seu carro, nem se quebra com os seus cavaleiros.

verses.original: גַּם־ זֹ֕את מֵעִ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יָצָ֑אָה הִפְלִ֣יא עֵצָ֔ה הִגְדִּ֖יל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- zōṯ mê·‘im Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yā·ṣā·’āh hip̄·lî ‘ê·ṣāh hiḡ·dîl tū·šî·yāh
verses.literal: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom
verses.literalPt: Até isto procede do SENHOR dos Exércitos; porque é maravilhoso em conselho e grande em obra.
